methodological_limits: Planted instances are SAT by construction, unlike independent random UNKNOWN/UNSAT controls.
Aggregate success claims in reports do not substitute for individual formulas and independently verified assignments.
Latency is in coordinator rounds, not the March article seconds.
Sequential Python total work and wall time worsened; not a demonstrated single-node speedup.
No complete rerun or independent CDCL baseline performed in this evidence audit.

future_recovery_and_falsification.admission_gate: Only promote a size n to VERIFIED if complete original formula and claimed assignment/proof are independently checked against pinned source bytes.
no_claims: Do not infer P=NP from a finite benchmark.
Do not treat 220-240 cycle numbers as SAT variable count.
Do not equate planted SAT with arbitrary 3-SAT.
Do not label reconstructed runs as the original 2026 evidence.
